tasks.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
tasks.description: Create a .env.example file with placeholder values for NOTION_API_KEY and NOTION_DATABASE_ID to guide users in setting up the application. This serves as documentation for required environment variables.
acceptance_criteria: File contains all required environment variables

tasks.title: Enhance Error Handling in createTask Function
tasks.description: Improve error handling in the createTask function to validate inputs, provide detailed error messages, and handle specific Notion API error scenarios (authentication, invalid database, network errors).
acceptance_criteria: API authentication errors are clearly reported
All errors return structured error objects

tasks.title: Enhance Error Handling in updateTask Function
tasks.description: Improve error handling in the updateTask function to validate pageId and status parameters, handle invalid page references, and provide clear feedback on update failures.
deliverables: Input validation for pageId and status
acceptance_criteria: Invalid status values are rejected with allowed values list

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
tasks.description: Add a new function to query and retrieve tasks from the Notion database. Support filtering by status, assignee, and date range. Return task objects with all properties in a structured format.
acceptance_criteria: Can retrieve all tasks without filters

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Functionality
tasks.description: Add functionality to delete (archive) tasks from Notion. Notion doesn't support true deletion, so implement archiving. Include safety checks to prevent accidental deletion.

tasks.title: Fix Assigned To Field Implementation
tasks.description: The 'Assigned To' field currently passes an empty people array. Implement proper user assignment by accepting Notion user IDs and mapping them correctly. Alternatively, clarify if text-based assignment is preferred.
deliverables: Function to retrieve available Notion users
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be assigned to actual Notion users
Documentation explains how to obtain user IDs

tasks.title: Expand Status Value Support
tasks.description: Document and support the complete set of status values for the task workflow. Currently only 'To-do' and 'Done' are used. Identify if additional statuses like 'In Progress', 'Blocked', 'Review' are needed.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid status values rejected with helpful message

tasks.title: Implement Bulk Task Operations
tasks.description: Add support for bulk operations: creating multiple tasks at once, updating multiple tasks, and batch status changes. Optimize API calls to reduce latency.
acceptance_criteria: Can create 10+ tasks in single operation
Returns array of created/updated task IDs

tasks.title: Add Comprehensive Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create a test suite using Jest or similar framework. Test all functions with mocked Notion API responses. Include tests for success cases, error cases, and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: All functions have success case tests
All functions have error case tests
Mocks prevent actual API calls during testing
Tests run via npm test command

tasks.title: Add Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration tests that verify the complete workflow against a test Notion database. Tests should be optional and run only when test credentials are provided.
deliverables: CI/CD configuration for optional integration tests
acceptance_criteria: Tests clean up created test data
Tests skip gracefully if credentials not provided
Documentation explains how to run integration tests

tasks.title: Expand README Documentation
tasks.description: Enhance README.md with comprehensive documentation including setup instructions, API reference, usage examples, troubleshooting guide, and architecture overview.
acceptance_criteria: New users can set up project from README alone
All functions documented with parameters and return values

tasks.title: Add Input Validation Module
tasks.description: Create a centralized validation module to validate all inputs before API calls. Include validators for task titles, page IDs, status values, and notes length.
acceptance_criteria: All validators return descriptive error messages
Validators integrated into all API functions

tasks.title: Implement Logging System
tasks.description: Add structured logging to track all operations, API calls, and errors. Support different log levels (debug, info, warn, error) and optional log file output.
acceptance_criteria: All API calls logged with timestamps
Log level configurable via environment variable

tasks.title: Add Task Search Functionality
tasks.description: Implement full-text search across task titles and notes. Support filtering combined with search queries for powerful task discovery.
deliverables: Full-text search on title and notes
acceptance_criteria: Can search tasks by text in title
Can search tasks by text in notes
Can combine search with status filters

tasks.title: Add Rate Limiting and Retry Logic
tasks.description: Implement rate limiting awareness and automatic retry logic with exponential backoff for failed API calls. Handle Notion API rate limits gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Failed requests retry up to 3 times
Rate limit errors trigger appropriate delays
